status: DONE: 9 Feedback style sets (8 new + Fluent/Spinner verified), review + strip, swap test 22/22, sweep, follow-ups, Fluent screens group.

sets.name: Fluent/Spinner
sets.note: existing (G3 Actions, already 18 variants); verified variant parity, not rebuilt

audit: Every fill and stroke in the 8 new sets is bound to a fluent/* role (card/* and table/* kept where the base binds them). No base instances left except .Slot (6, Empty state media=image; no Fluent .Slot exists).

recipes.Alert / Inline notice: WinUI InfoBar: radius/control 4, 1px fluent/stroke/card, severity backgrounds (success-bg, caution-bg, critical-bg; info = card/secondary = WinUI AttentionBackground; neutral = card/default; important = fluent/badge/brand/*, derived). Severity mark 16: info-filled in text/secondary (neutral, info) or brand/fg (important); error_circle filled in system/caution (warning); a 16 disc in system/success or system/critical holding checkmark_12 / dismiss_12 in text/inverse (success, destructive). One label Body Strong text/primary, body text/primary on the label column. Literal padding 14/12/14/16, gap 10 (inline 8/8/8/12, gap 8). strong (derived): 1px stroke in the severity colour (neutral/info: stroke/surface).
recipes.Toast: Notification flyout (F.flyout): solid/base under card/default (status types under their severity background), 1px stroke/surface, r8, shadow16 (R.float + ambient 0 0 2 #0000001f). Same severity marks; loading = Fluent/Spinner. Title text/primary, message text/secondary. Timer track stroke/divider, bar in the severity colour (text/secondary for default/info/loading). Action = Fluent/Button / sm (standard), close = Fluent/Icon button / xs ghost.
recipes.Progress: WinUI ProgressBar: 1px fluent/control/strong rail (theme-only part 'rail') under a 3px r1.5 bar; primary text/primary (F.neutral), secondary text/secondary, success/warning/destructive = fluent/system/*. Every size is 3 tall (WinUI has one height).
recipes.Progress circular: WinUI ProgressRing: track layer kept but unpainted, round-cap arc in the same ink map.
recipes.Skeleton: Derived (WinUI has none): bone fluent/stroke/divider (#0000000f / #ffffff15, the Fluent 2 stencil analogue), radius/badge 4, avatar circle.
recipes.Skeleton preset: Fluent/Skeleton bones; table preset drops the head rule (Fluent ListView).
recipes.Empty state: 40 (sm 32) r4 tile in subtle/secondary with the Fluent glyph in text/secondary (error: critical-bg tile + critical glyph); title Subtitle text/primary, description text/secondary; actions Fluent/Button md accent + standard; border=true is an F.card (card/default, solid 1px stroke/card, r8).

swapTest: 22/22: Alert, Inline notice, Toast, Progress, Progress circular, Spinner, Empty state and Skeleton preset base instances with text/boolean overrides and a custom title, swapped to Fluent/* in Light and Dark; every override and title survived.

sweep.Fluent/Data table: follows the Table main; its nested empty state is no-results ('No orders match “SO-99999”'), as the base Data table.
sweep.Navigation follow-up: 74 base Location marker -> Fluent/Location marker: 40 in mains (Tab / horizontal 24, Nav menu item 10, Command palette 6); Tabs list, Tabs, Navigation menu and Top bar follow their mains.

sweep.Alert/Toast/Progress: no other base Feedback instances exist in Fluent's earlier sets (recount: only .Slot and Fluent color glyphs remain).

Alert/Inline/Toast severity marks mix two drawings: the filled FSI twins (info-filled, error_circle filled) where one exists, and a drawn 16 disc + 12 glyph for success and destructive (no checkmark_circle / dismiss_circle filled component in the 51-glyph set). Warning and destructive stay distinct shapes (! vs x).
important tone uses the Fluent 2 brand tint badge roles (blue tint, not the accent fill).
Progress: every size draws the 3px WinUI bar; the size axis only changes the label type.
Skeleton bone binds fluent/stroke/divider (a stroke role used as a fill), the closest existing role to a Fluent 2 stencil.
Screens keep Lucide glyphs where the Utility screens override a glyph (14 shared glyphs), as every other style's screens do.
ownerReview: Strong Alert emphasis is derived (WinUI has none): a 1px severity-coloured edge on the same tint. Decide whether Fluent should drop 'strong' to identical subtle.

Table loading now shows Fluent skeleton rows instead of G3's ProgressRing stand-in row (kept hidden as 'loading-row'); revert by toggling the two layers if Fluent should load with a ring.
